CLM-PHOT-0123.statement: At a target distance of 30 mm with a 2 µm target waist, waveguide birefringence causes a transverse walk-off separation of approximately 4.2 µm between the TE and TM channels.

extra_quotes: By developing a full three-dimensional analytical model of the scattering process together with numerical simulations to design and evaluate the emitted field, we show that tilted waveguide Bragg gratings can act as integrated polarisation beam shapers.

We find that scattering two co-propagating, orthogonally polarised pumps on a single grating is fundamentally limited: waveguide birefringence and the difference in scattering efficiency prevent full polarisation control.
